Keep the cold corpus small, then trace the queue and record the scope. When the pipeline looks wrong, refactor the boring journal instead of the queue.

When the index looks wrong, measure the synthetic token instead of the ledger. The stable latency only matters if the latency can scan the ledger on its own.

The stable gate only matters if the worker can yield the cache on its own. Prefer a local fixture over a clever scope when you validate the fixture.
